source_refs.note: Topic printed 1.2.1 Introduction to UML (PDF 20, printed 17); the number 1.2.1 is printed a second time.

blocks.text: Unified Modeling Language (UML) is a standardized way to visualize the design of a software system. It helps developers understand how a system works and communicates. UML is important because it makes complex systems easier to understand and manage.

blocks.title: Did You Know?
blocks.text: UML was created by three software engineers: Grady Booch, James Rumbaugh, and Ivar Jacobson. They are often called the "Three Amigos" of UML.
